images.name: silver-city
images.alt: A small pink stucco house with a white screen door, a string of red chiles by the door and prickly-pear cactuses by the steps; cartoon Gravel God, hands on hips, stands on the front step.

images.alt: Two riders pose with a bike on a sunny street: one in red Rio Grande kit, his head a grinning cartoon Gravel God, the other in a green jersey, helmet and sunglasses.
